agents.basis: files matching <plugin>/agents/*.md, one per agent role, with name / color / model / maxTurns / disallowedTools read from the YAML frontmatter between the first two --- lines; the directory is the plugin's own install path resolved from $0 (overridable via FLOOR_AGENTS_DIR), NOT a repo-relative one

automate_runs.basis: files matching .supervisor/automate/*.md, which excludes the sibling *.config-backup.json transients

drain_rounds.basis: files matching .supervisor/drain-rounds/*.json, each parsed as a JSON document

insights_runs.basis: files matching .supervisor/insights/runs/*.md, one note per summarized run

logs.basis: files matching .supervisor/logs/*.jsonl, an extension glob; the same directory also holds plain .log dispatch transcripts which are deliberately NOT counted here

postmortem.basis: non-blank lines in .supervisor/postmortem/results.jsonl that parse as a JSON object, one record per line

entries.evidence: the reviewer asked for the pinned literal and got a variant
a guard was added that could never fire
three fix cycles inside one drain, emitted as ONE category object
the offender was never named in the reason string

rules.basis: files matching .agent/rules/*.json, each parsed as a JSON document; the sibling README.md is not counted

rules.statement: First of two rules sharing an id. Drives supersedes.duplicate_ids. NOTE: neither copy carries supersedes, so this fixture does not exercise the edge-map merge; when duplicates DO carry different supersedes values the merge is LAST-write-wins, which is documented at the edge_map site in build-floor.sh.
Second rule sharing that id - must not silently replace the first.
supersedes names this rule's OWN id, so it supersedes nothing. Drives supersedes.self_referential.

sessions.basis: distinct non-empty cc_session_id values across every line of .supervisor/logs/*.jsonl, grouped by that FIELD and never by filename, so one file may contribute many sessions and one session may span many files

state.basis: rows matching a leading numeric cell inside the ## Subtasks table of .supervisor/state.md
